summary: Completed comprehensive testing of email verification/authentication and Stripe billing features. All backend APIs (19/19) and frontend flows passed successfully. Email is MOCKED (SendGrid skip-mode) with dev codes/links shown on-screen. Stripe is in TEST mode with real checkout.stripe.com redirects.
passed_tests: Backend: Register new user returns verification_required + dev_code (no session)
Backend: Login before verification blocked with 403
Backend: Verify email with wrong code returns 400
Backend: Verify email with correct code returns 200 + access_token + email_verified=true
Backend: Login after verification succeeds
Backend: Resend verification for verified email returns 400
Backend: Re-register verified email returns 400
Backend: Forgot password returns dev_link in skip-mode
Backend: Existing accounts (demo@civicsign.com, admin@civicsign.com) login normally
Backend: Resend verification for unverified email returns new dev_code
Backend: GET /api/billing/plans returns Pro=$15.00, Business=$49.00 USD
Backend: POST /api/billing/checkout for current plan returns 400
Backend: POST /api/billing/checkout for different plan returns checkout.stripe.com URL + session_id
Backend: POST /api/billing/checkout with invalid plan_id returns 400
Backend: GET /api/billing/status/{session_id} shows status=open, payment_status=unpaid before payment
Backend: Payment transaction record created with status=initiated, payment_status=pending, processed=false
Frontend: Register form → redirects to /verify-email with dev_code displayed
Frontend: Enter verification code → redirects to /dashboard
Frontend: Login with unverified account → redirects to /verify-email with fresh dev_code
Frontend: Forgot password dialog → shows dev_link with copy/open buttons
Frontend: Existing account login (demo@civicsign.com) → dashboard
Frontend: Subscription page shows all plans (Free $0, Pro $15, Business $49)
Frontend: Stripe secure payment note present
Frontend: Upgrade to Business button → redirects to checkout.stripe.com with US$49.00
Frontend: Dashboard, Templates, Settings pages load correctly
Frontend: Admin portal (/admin/login) accessible
Regression: All existing flows (dashboard, envelopes, templates, settings) work
